name: gedit
description: The Gedit package contains a lightweight UTF-8 text editor for the GNOME Desktop. It needs a group of packages to be installed before Gedit itself. This page will install all of them.

user:
for package in \
   libgedit-amtk-5.9.2.tar.bz2            \
   libgedit-gtksourceview-299.5.0.tar.bz2 \
   libgedit-gfls-0.3.1.tar.bz2            \
   libgedit-tepl-6.13.0.tar.bz2
do
  packagedir=${package%.tar*}
  echo "Building $packagedir"
  tar -xf ../$package
  meson setup $packagedir/build --prefix=/usr       \
            --buildtype=release \
            -D gtk_doc=false $packagedir
  ninja -C $packagedir/build
done
package:
for package in \
   libgedit-amtk-5.9.2.tar.bz2            \
   libgedit-gtksourceview-299.5.0.tar.bz2 \
   libgedit-gfls-0.3.1.tar.bz2            \
   libgedit-tepl-6.13.0.tar.bz2
do
  packagedir=${package%.tar*}
  DESTDIR=$DESTDIR ninja -C $packagedir/build install
done
